a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.title: In-Patient Treatment Benefits
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.full_text: The Insured Person shall be entitled to In-Patient treatment benefits including room and board, nursing services, intensive care, operating theatre, surgeon fees, anaesthesia, diagnostic investigations, medicines, medical devices, and all associated medical expenses incurred during hospitalisation at a Network Provider, subject to pre-authorisation from the Company.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.title: Out-Patient Treatment Benefits
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.full_text: The Company shall cover Out-Patient consultation, diagnostic services, laboratory tests, radiology, prescribed medications, and specialist referrals at Network Providers. A co-payment of 20% of the eligible charges shall apply, subject to a maximum of AED 50 per visit.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.title: Emergency Treatment Benefits
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.full_text: Emergency medical treatment shall be covered at any facility worldwide. In the UAE, emergency treatment at non-network facilities shall be reimbursed at the network rate. Outside the UAE, emergency medical expenses up to AED 500,000 shall be covered per incident, subject to the overall annual limit.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.title: Maternity Benefits
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.full_text: Maternity benefits shall be provided after a waiting period of 12 months from the coverage start date. Normal delivery: covered up to AED 10,000. Caesarean section: covered up to AED 15,000. Antenatal and postnatal consultations are included. Newborn coverage for the first 30 days from birth is included at no additional premium.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.title: Co-Payment Schedule
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.full_text: Co-payment structure: Out-Patient consultations: 20% co-pay, maximum AED 50 per visit. In-Patient: AED 200 per admission, maximum AED 500 per policy year. Diagnostic services: 20% co-pay, maximum AED 50 per visit. Pharmacy (out-patient): 10% co-pay. Emergency: No co-pay.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.title: Benefit Sub-Limits
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.full_text: The following annual sub-limits apply within the overall policy limit: Dental treatment: AED 5,000. Optical (frames and lenses): AED 2,000. Alternative medicine (Ayurveda, homeopathy, acupuncture): AED 2,000. Physiotherapy: 20 sessions per year. Mental health: 12 outpatient sessions per year. Home nursing: 30 days per year.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.title: General Exclusions
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.full_text: The following are excluded from coverage: Cosmetic or aesthetic treatment (unless medically necessary following an accident); Treatment for obesity or weight management (unless medically necessary); Experimental or unproven treatments; Self-inflicted injuries; Injuries arising from participation in professional sports; Treatment outside the territorial limit except emergency; Infertility treatment (IVF, ICSI); Sexual dysfunction treatment; Hazardous activities and extreme sports.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.title: Pre-Existing Condition Exclusion
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.full_text: Pre-existing medical conditions shall be covered after a continuous waiting period of 6 months from the coverage start date, provided the condition was declared at the time of enrolment. Undisclosed pre-existing conditions discovered during the claim process shall be excluded for the entire policy period and may result in policy cancellation.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.title: Pre-Authorisation Requirements
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-100000000001.full_text: Pre-authorisation is mandatory for: All in-patient admissions (planned); All daycare procedures; Advanced diagnostic imaging (MRI, CT scan, PET scan); Maternity admission. Emergency admissions must be notified within 24 hours. Failure to obtain pre-authorisation for planned procedures may result in a 30% penalty on the approved amount.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.title: In-Patient Treatment
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.full_text: We will cover the following Medical Expenses incurred in respect of Hospitalisation of the Insured Person during the Policy Period, up to the Sum Insured: Room Rent (Single AC Room), Boarding, Nursing Expenses, ICU charges (no sub-limit), Surgeon fees, Anaesthesia, Blood, Oxygen, Operation theatre charges, Diagnostic materials, Medicines and drugs, Medical devices. Note: Associated Medical expenses which vary based on the room occupied by the insured person will be considered in proportion to the room rent stated in the policy schedule or actuals whichever is less.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.title: Room Rent Proportionate Deduction
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.full_text: If the Insured Person occupies a room with rent exceeding the eligible room rent as per the policy schedule, all associated medical expenses that vary based on room category shall be reduced proportionately. Formula: Payable Amount = Billed Amount × (Eligible Room Rent / Actual Room Rent). This proportionate deduction applies to: Surgeon fees, Anaesthetist fees, Specialist consultation fees, Operation theatre charges, and any other charges that differ based on room category. ICU charges and expenses that do not vary by room category are not subject to proportionate deduction.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.title: Pre and Post Hospitalisation
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.full_text: Medical expenses incurred during 60 days prior to the date of admission and 90 days after the date of discharge, related to the disease/illness/injury for which the Insured Person was hospitalised, shall be covered under the policy.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.title: Daycare Procedures
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.full_text: The Company covers 546 listed daycare procedures that require hospitalisation of less than 24 hours due to advances in medical technology. These include but are not limited to: Cataract surgery, Dialysis, Chemotherapy, Radiotherapy, Lithotripsy, Tonsillectomy, Arthroscopy, and all procedures listed in Appendix B.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.title: Waiting Periods
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.full_text: Initial Waiting Period: 30 days from the policy start date (except for accidents). Specific Diseases Waiting Period: 24 months from the policy start date for: Cataract, Benign ENT disorders, Hernia, Joint replacement, Kidney/Urinary stone treatment, Piles/Fistula, Sinusitis, Internal tumours. Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period: 36 months from the first policy start date for all declared pre-existing conditions.

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.title: Permanent Exclusions
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.full_text: The Company shall not be liable for expenses on account of: Cosmetic or plastic surgery (unless necessitated by accident or burns); External congenital anomalies; War, invasion, act of foreign enemy; Nuclear/chemical/biological weapons contamination; Circumcision unless medically necessary; Vaccination except for post-bite treatment; Cost of spectacles, hearing aids, and contact lenses; Treatment for Change of gender; Treatment for Obesity/Weight management (BMI-based exclusion).

a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.title: Ambulance Charges
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-200000000001.full_text: Road ambulance expenses incurred for transportation of the insured person to and from the hospital shall be covered subject to a maximum of Rs. 2,500 per hospitalisation.
